description: Source code for a Linux kernel module implementing DES encryption/decryption using hardware acceleration on Lantiq/Infineon platform. Contains driver registration, context management, and asynchronous request handling for DES and 3DES algorithms.

methods.name: lq_des_setkey
methods.description: Sets the DES key in the context for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: lq_des3_ede_setkey
methods.description: Sets the 3DES EDE key in the context.

methods.name: lq_deu_des_core
methods.description: Main interface to hardware DES engine for encrypt/decrypt operations.

methods.name: lq_queue_mgr
methods.description: Manages queuing of DES requests and initiates hardware processing.

methods.name: lq_des_alg
methods.description: Structure representing DES algorithms supported by the driver.

methods.name: lqdeu_async_des_init
methods.description: Initializes and registers DES algorithms with the kernel crypto API.

methods.name: lqdeu_fini_async_des
methods.description: Unregisters DES algorithms and cleans up driver resources.
